title: Senate staff meet Mellon, Puthoff, Davis, the Skinwalker team and the Tic Tac pilots
summary: Kurt McConnell tells of Senate staff meet Mellon, Puthoff, Davis, the Skinwalker team and the Tic Tac pilots, about 2017-2018 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Capitol Hill, Washington, D.C.; Skinwalker Ranch, Utah

tellings.quote: I saw his name associated with this and it was easy to uh reconnect with with Chris and we met Lou and we met Dr. Put off and Dr. Davis and uh um uh we met the f other folks who had been working on the um on the ranch in uh in in in Utah and we met Brandon Fugal,

plain: A former US Senate staff member, Kurt McConnell, says that around 2017 and 2018 he and other Senate staff in Washington met a string of people tied to the UFO subject: Chris Mellon, Lou Elizondo, Dr. Harold Puthoff and Dr. Eric Davis. He says they also met people who had worked at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for strange reports, including its owner Brandon Fugal, and the Navy pilots David Fravor and Alex Dietrich, who reported the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint. He tells it as the moment Congress began hearing these accounts directly.
